description: Use this when the user asks for historical AI mentions or AI search volume for a licensed website, including case-study growth. Resolve the Crew and website first, then request each platform separately. Report the platform, US/English scope, and compared completed months. The monthly counts are DataForSEO estimates; they are not historical citation counts, referrals, or proof of causation.

query.description: Required filter: platform (CHAT_GPT or GOOGLE). The response contains US/English monthly mention counts and estimated AI search volume.

name: get_ai_visibility_history
title: Get monthly AI visibility history
